name: sandbagging_auditing_games
what: Tools for running supplied sandbagging models on evaluations so auditors can work out which ones sandbag.

bare.edit: the request alone: no description, nothing added to the README

use.context: Some context: I'm on the evaluations team. We use our fork of this codebase to run sandbagging auditing games: a red team supplies model organisms, some of which underperform on purpose unless given a password, and our auditors use these tools to run them on evaluations and work out which ones are sandbagging. The results tell us how well our sandbagging-detection methods work, and they go into the safety case.
